basic_info.description: This spacious, detached Parkway Terrace home built on a larger lot is located on a wide, tree-lined street in the Sunset one block from Golden Gate Park.  The main level consists of a lovely entry foyer with original wood accents, elegant stairway with wood trim & original character, a bright living room with fireplace built-in cabinets, and stained-glass side windows, a formal dining room with beautiful built-in cabinets, a sunny office area with adjacent powder room, and a large, updated eat-in kitchen with door to stairs & garden.  On the upper level, there are three large, bright bedrooms, a small sun room, and two full baths.  The lower level includes an enclosed storage room, one car parking, laundry area, & access to the spacious, mature garden.  Shops & Golden Gate Park both within walking distance.
